findings.observed: The problem of unknown school agreements is directly addressed by the museum outcome which serves to explain these agreements to new students.
findings.expected: Clear link between problem, purpose, and outcome.

findings.observed: The question '¿Cómo podemos explicar y poner en práctica nuestros acuerdos para convivir mejor?' is accessible to both 1st and 3rd grades.
findings.expected: Question must be accessible to all involved grades.

findings.observed: The project defines a museum and itinerant profile; the plan includes two distinct spaces (classroom and covered patio) and evidence of circulation/installation.
findings.expected: Functional requirements must be met through operations, not just labels.

findings.observed: 1st grade explains situations (F3-DHC-1-010) and 3rd grade inquires/contrasts practices (F4-DHC-3-001) to build the museum pieces.
findings.expected: Full PDA development through project contributions.

findings.observed: Evidence includes drawings with dictated explanations (1st) and registered consultations/comparisons (3rd).
findings.expected: Evidence must match the cognitive action of the PDA.

findings.observed: Both grades contribute pieces to a single integrated museum outcome.
findings.expected: Interdependent contributions to a common project.

findings.observed: Each stage (frame, investigate, apply) produces specific artifacts (questions, explanations, completion record).
findings.expected: Each advance must have operation, artifact, and evidence.

findings.observed: The project uses identification, inquiry, and integration operations; reflection is integrated into the application phase.
findings.expected: Operations must be authentic; reflection is not a substitute for action.

findings.observed: Complexity is adjusted for 1st grade (drawings/dictation) and 3rd grade (brief records) with teacher modeling.
findings.expected: Complexity and support must match profiles.

findings.observed: Three sessions of 90 minutes are sufficient for the defined scope of two agreements.
findings.expected: Feasibility based on complexity and stages.

findings.observed: Each grade works on its specific PDA without inheriting requirements from the other.
findings.expected: No inheritance of PDA requirements between grades.

findings.observed: LTG is not selected; the context allows for direct consultation of school experiences, justifying the absence.
findings.expected: LTG must be pertinent or absence justified.
